clinician.final_diagnosis: CNS PTLD, specifically high-grade diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) of the activated B-cell phenotype
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 64-year-old post liver transplant woman on immunosuppression presented with focal neurological deficits, papilledema, and negative CT for hemorrhage. Brain MRI revealed multiple ring-enhancing lesions with vasogenic edema. CSF analysis was ordered but no results reported. Stereotactic brain biopsy confirmed diffuse infiltration of intermediate to large mononuclear cells positive for CD20, consistent with B-cell lymphoma. Though detailed immunophenotyping results were not fully documented, the diagnosis of high-grade DLBCL of activated B-cell phenotype was clinically established as CNS PTLD.
